decisions.reason: ERC-721C changes how the $10 secondary-sale royalty is enforced, but it does not change the rule that secondary royalties contribute to the Small Block pool.
The current FAQ prize and reward copy does not specify the NFT token standard or marketplace-enforcement mechanism, and its existing flat-$10-royalty statement remains valid.
Marketplace whitelisting changes royalty enforcement but does not alter which book, referral-code, badge, or ticket state transfers with the NFT.
The About-page state does not assert a conflicting NFT standard or secondary-marketplace policy, so the ERC-721C choice requires no necessary copy change.
The optional PDF-download behavior is independent of the NFT standard and secondary-sale royalty enforcement.
The ERC-721C decision applies to secondary-marketplace royalty enforcement and does not change primary-mint revenue allocations.
The token-standard and marketplace-whitelist decision does not change badge triggers, destinations, thresholds, or functions.
Choosing ERC-721C instead of standard ERC-721 does not change the confirmed Base network deployment requirement.
Secondary-sale royalty enforcement does not change the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or delivery of commissions for referral-code mints.
The deferred Discord community requirement is unrelated to the NFT standard and secondary-marketplace royalty enforcement.
ERC-721C marketplace controls do not change fiat buyers' wallet provisioning, dashboard access, ticket visibility, commission access, or prize access.
The secondary-sale enforcement mechanism does not change the $15 primary mint price or its advertised pricing commitment.
